video.title: AI欧腐《海妖爱上了直男/A Male Siren Fell for a Straight Guy》
video.desc:
经典剧本
Marine researcher Elliott teaches Triton to court, unaware the merman is a siren who sees it as a proposal. Hunted and marked as his mate, Elliott uncovers a childhood bond behind their dangerous reunion.

海洋研究员 Elliott 教 Triton 如何求偶，却不知道这条人鱼其实是海妖，而且把这当成了求婚。被追猎、被标记为伴侣之后，Elliott 才发现，这场危险的重逢背后，藏着两人童年时结下的羁绊。
